scripts.lint: pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:css && pnpm lint:md && pnpm format:check
scripts.lint:deno: cd supabase/functions && deno lint && deno fmt --check && deno check */index.ts
scripts.lint:sql: sqlfluff lint supabase/migrations supabase/tests supabase/test-support supabase/seed.sql
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && pnpm --filter @24m/web typecheck && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test:deno: cd supabase/functions && rm -rf ../../coverage/deno && deno test --allow-read --allow-env --coverage=../../coverage/deno && deno coverage ../../coverage/deno --lcov --output=../../coverage/deno.lcov --exclude='_test\.ts$|test_util\.ts$|/lib/|index\.ts$|deps\.ts$' && node ../../scripts/coverage-gate.mjs ../../coverage/deno.lcov 95 90 95
scripts.test:all: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:deno && pnpm test:db
